nonnumeric_answer_examples.question: Tom read a book in 3 days. On the first day he read 1/5 of the book, on the second day he read 2/5, and on the third day he read the rest of the book. How much did he read on the third day?

John wants to set up the background for his aquarium. He buys 1200 centimeters of decorative stone. He divides it into 30-centimeter sections. He uses 1/3 of that for the setup. How much does he use for the setup?
It takes Benjamin 20 minutes to walk around the park three times. If walking around the park once is 0.5 km long, how many minutes does Benjamin takes to walk one km?
The cost of 5 pencils and 2 erasers is $3. Each pencil costs $0.5 and each eraser costs $0.75. How much change will you get from a $5 bill?
Bobby saves $20 every week. His sister Judy saves twice as much as Bobby and their brother Mike saves half as much as Bobby. How much money do the three of them save together each week?
Wesley has a collection of $240. He spent 1/3 of his money on video games and 1/4 of his remaining money on comics. How much money does Wesley have left?

Emily and Lucy plan to meet at the coffee shop. It takes Emily 15 minutes to get there and it takes Lucy double the time to get there. If Emily leaves her house at 3:00 p.m., at what time should Lucy leave her house so that they both arrive at the same time?
A pie is cut into 8 equal slices. After a party, there are 2 slices left. What fraction of the pie is left?
Benjamin wrote 25 songs this year. If 15 of his songs are about love, 5 about friendship, and the rest are about his adventures, what fraction of his songs are about adventures?
Sam has a container of juice. He drank 1/4 of it and his friend Bob drank 1/2 out of the remaining juice. What fraction of juice is left in the container?
